messages:
Alex Rivera: Heads-up — we're going to deprecate the old model alias mapping (v1) next week. I opened a docs PR with a redirect map and migration notes: https://go.redwood/docs/pr/7891

Maria Chen: Thanks. Link?

Alex Rivera: https://go.redwood/docs/pr/7891 — PR edits the alias table + adds a small CLI note. Key gotcha: CLI `rw models alias` will still accept old aliases but won't write redirects; we need to show the JSON redirect snippet and a how-to for ops.

Sam O'Neill: Can you paste the recommended redirect JSON here? easier to copy.

Alex Rivera: Sure:
```
{
  "old_alias": "gpt-3.5-open-legacy",
  "new_model": "gpt-4o-mini",
  "fallbacks": ["gpt-3.5-open", "gpt-4o-small"]
}
```
Add to docs under /model-aliases/redirects.md and mention TTL for redirects (72h) so clients flush caches.

Maria Chen: Also flag SDKs — v2 SDK ignores `old_alias` in some edgecases, we should add a code sample for graceful fallback that checks model availability and retries. @Chris can we add snippet?

Chris Patel: Yep. I'll add a TypeScript example showing `tryModelSwap()` with exponential backoff and a cache-bust header. Will link to the PR.

docs-bot: PR updated: 1758884321-PR-7891 — added redirect snippet + CLI note. Review requested from @Maria Chen, @Chris Patel.

Sam O'Neill: Quick nit — can we avoid suggesting 2xx token costs calc? that's on the infra docs. Keep this focused.

Alex Rivera: Good call. I'll remove the cost paragraph and add a pointer to infra page. Also need an ops checklist for Dedicated customers (manual alias migration steps).

Maria Chen: I'll write the ops checklist after Chris lands the SDK snippet. We should aim to ship the docs and a deprecation banner on the alias endpoint on Wed.

Chris Patel: On it, target end-of-day Tue for TS snippet.

Alex Rivera: Thanks all :thumbsup:
